title: Event Production Melbourne | Sonido
description: Event production in Melbourne. Sound system design, setup and operation for private, corporate and public events.
introCopy: We plan and run the technical side of events across Melbourne. Sound, setup and operation, from a single room through to a full warehouse build.
approachCopy: Tell us what you are planning and we will assess the space, the sound requirements and the equipment the event needs.
We handle specification, delivery, installation and operation on the day, then pack down afterwards. One point of contact for the technical side of the event.

services.heading: Sound system design
services.copy: Specified to the room and the expected numbers, indoor or outdoor.

services.heading: Setup and operation
services.copy: Installed, tested and operated for the duration of the event.

services.heading: Equipment supply
services.copy: Audio, DJ equipment and lighting, supplied and configured.

servicesNote: Scope and pricing are confirmed on enquiry.
hireCopy: Speakers, DJ equipment and full systems are available on a 24 hour dry hire.
